name: Tamarillo
description: Egg-shaped tart fruit with tomato-like flesh, eaten scooped from the skin.

tcm.note: A new-world fruit; read with the nightshades, which are cooling.

histamine.note: A nightshade like tomato, and tomato is one of the highest fresh foods on the SIGHI list.

nutrition.highlight: a tomato that grows on a tree
